none: PAS NLM-B2AE35: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine from Winteringham
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin: Nummus fraction, possibly of Constantius II, Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust right. Three parallel ruled lines are scored across the bust, from circa 4 O'clock; another line originating from 1 O'clock intersects them. Obverse inscription: [---]TIVS AVG. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Diameter: 17.5mm, Weight: 1.67gms, die axis: probably 12
